name: Project Budget Alert
description: Monitors government and enterprise project budgets on a recurring schedule. Queries the project finance database for spending across all active projects, runs variance analysis against approved budget ceilings, filters projects that exceed configurable thresholds, and routes notifications by severity level — email for warnings, push notification for critical overruns. Designed for public-sector financial controllers and enterprise PMOs who need proactive budget oversight.

data.label: Run budget check every weekday at 8 AM
Query active project budgets and expenditures

config.query: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.department, p.approved_budget, COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) AS total_spent, p.approved_budget - COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) AS remaining, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) / p.approved_budget * 100, 2) AS pct_used FROM projects p LEFT JOIN expenditures e ON p.id = e.project_id WHERE p.status = 'active' AND p.fiscal_year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY pct_used DESC

data.label: Compute budget variance and risk scores

config.code: const projects = input.rows; return projects.map(p => ({ ...p, variance: p.approved_budget - p.total_spent, riskScore: p.pct_used >= 100 ? 'critical' : p.pct_used >= 85 ? 'warning' : 'healthy', daysRemaining: Math.ceil((new Date(p.end_date) - new Date()) / 86400000), burnRate: p.total_spent / Math.max(1, Math.ceil((new Date() - new Date(p.start_date)) / 86400000)) }));

data.label: Keep only projects exceeding 80% budget usage

config.message: CRITICAL: Project '{{project.name}}' ({{project.department}}) has used {{project.pct_used}}% of its ${{project.approved_budget}} budget. Only ${{project.remaining}} remains. Immediate review required.

data.label: Email budget warning to project manager

config.subject: Budget Warning: {{project.name}} at {{project.pct_used}}% utilization
config.body:
Dear {{project.manager_name}},

This is an automated alert that project '{{project.name}}' in the {{project.department}} department has reached {{project.pct_used}}% of its approved budget of ${{project.approved_budget}}.

Total Spent: ${{project.total_spent}}
Remaining: ${{project.remaining}}
Estimated Burn Rate: ${{project.burnRate}}/day

Please review current commitments and submit a budget amendment if needed.

Regards,
Budget Monitoring System
